title: Peer/receipt: any contact can forge delivery/read status for any message
description: ReceiptHandler (kith-peer/src/lib.rs:363) does not extract or check the caller's WhoIs identity. It only checks sender_id == 'self' and delivery_state \!= Received. Any authenticated contact — even one who was never in the conversation — can call Peer/receipt with any outgoing message ID and flip its delivery/read state. Owner UI shows incorrect delivery status.
